summary: Spec fidelity: the brief (F4 acceptance: 'status' red and the guard's refusal 'give the same reason') and the titles of gate.ci-run.02/03/04/06 say the reason is named in status too. `canon status` shows a shipped subject's red as `1 uncovered-cell (first: game.run.01)`: shipped_red groups by class and prints no reason, so no_ci_run, dirty_worktree, short_run and code_tree_unknown are indistinguishable there and other_code_tree is only 'stale-evidence'. gate check and the ship guard do name the reason (verified live). assert_three_readers asserts only the class and the scenario id in status, so the claim is not proven. Also status's red exists for shipped subjects only: with the allowed `scope: [verifying, shipped]` a verifying subject whose newest evidence is a person's is red in gate check and clean in status (probed). Fix: put the reason in the status red line (the first violation's `spec_coverage.require_ci_run: <reason>`) and assert it, or amend the brief and scenarios to say status gives the class only and the human accepts that. Blast radius: shipped_red serves every guard check, so changing its line changes status text for all of them (conformance cases).
